teaser.en: Its black, mealy fruits taste sweet enough to earn it the English name chocolate berry.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake meusi yenye unga-unga ni matamu kiasi cha kuupatia jina la Kiingereza *chocolate berry*.

summary.en: *Mfudu*, the chocolate berry, is a small deciduous tree of hot, low wooded grassland in Kwale and Kilifi. Its sweet black fruit is eaten, and its straight stems give poles, spoons and tool handles.
summary.sw: *Mfudu* ni mti mdogo unaopukutisha majani wa nyika za joto za nyanda za chini zenye miti huko Kwale na Kilifi. Tunda lake tamu jeusi huliwa, na mashina yake yaliyonyooka hutoa nguzo, miiko na mipini ya zana.

about.en:
*Mfudu* is a small deciduous tree up to about 8 metres. Its young branchlets are square in cross-section and covered in rusty, woolly hairs. The leaves usually have five leaflets spread like the fingers of a hand.

The fruits ripen black, with a mealy, sweet pulp.
about.sw:
*Mfudu* ni mti mdogo unaopukutisha majani, unaofikia hadi mita 8 hivi. Vitawi vyake vichanga vina umbo la mraba vikikatwa, na vimefunikwa na manyoya ya rangi ya kutu kama sufu. Kwa kawaida majani yake yana vijani vitano vilivyotandazwa kama vidole vya mkono.

Matunda yake huiva yakawa meusi, yakiwa na nyama tamu ya unga-unga.

where.en: It grows in the hot, low wooded grassland of Kwale and Kilifi.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika za joto za nyanda za chini zenye miti huko Kwale na Kilifi.

uses.en: The black, sweet, mealy fruit is eaten. The straight stems are cut for poles, and the wood is carved into spoons and tool handles.
uses.sw: Tunda lake jeusi, tamu na la unga-unga huliwa. Mashina yaliyonyooka hukatwa kuwa nguzo, na mti wake huchongwa kuwa miiko na mipini ya zana.

culture.en: *Mfudu* is the reference point for its relatives: the Digo name *mfudu madzi*, the 'watery *mfudu*', and *mfudu unga*, the 'floury *mfudu*', by comparing their fruit with this one.
culture.sw: *Mfudu* ndio kipimo cha jamaa zake: Wadigo wanaita *mfudu madzi*, '*mfudu* wa maji', na *mfudu unga*, '*mfudu* wa unga', kwa kulinganisha matunda yao na ya mti huu.

names.en: Pakia and Maundu and Tengnäs record the Digo name *mfudu*, which is also the Swahili name. Chonyi speakers call it *mfudu unga*, which in Digo is the name of a different tree, the black plum. In English it is the chocolate berry, and its scientific name is *Vitex payos*.
names.sw: Pakia, pamoja na Maundu na Tengnäs, wanarekodi jina la Kidigo *mfudu*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kiswahili. Wazungumzaji wa Kichonyi huuita *mfudu unga*, ambalo kwa Kidigo ni jina la mti mwingine, *black plum*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *chocolate berry*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Vitex payos*.

reason.en: Another wild fruit of the coastal bush
reason.sw: Tunda jingine la porini la vichaka vya pwani
